{{Top}}
[[File:TacticalDroid-GaW.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] uses a tractor beam to move a large stone.]]
{{Quote|We're caught in a tractor beam! It's pulling us in!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
A '''tractor beam''' was a projected force field used by spaceports, planetary bases, space stations, and starships to effectively grasp and guide vessels to a safe designated landing. They could also be used to forcibly capture enemy ships. The [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] was equipped with 768 tractor-beam generators, enabling it to constrain ships such as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] with ease.

==Design==
A tractor beam was a powerful invisible [[Force field/Legends|force field]] that was generated and projected by a [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projector]]. The more powerful the tractor beam, the greater mass it could move or hold still, and the greater range it had.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> The tractor beam, when projected into space, could capture and redirect objects.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

==Application and use==
{{Quote|They've got a tractor beam on us. I can't break free!|[[Kyle Katarn]]|<ref name="JediAcademy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>}}
Commercial use tractor beams were installed aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] such as [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and [[Container ship/Legends|container ships]]. They were primarily used to move cargo modules.<ref name="EGWT" /> Tractor beams were also used to help guide [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] into a safe landing at [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]], as well as to aid with the loading and unloading of cargo.<ref name="DF:RA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref> Other uses include salvage operation, positioning of [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] and [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]], and removing debris from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|lanes]].<ref name="NEGWT" /> Some ships also had personnel-retrieval tractor beams, enabling them to rescue extravehicular personnel.

[[Warship/Legends|Warships]], such as [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], boasted powerful military-grade tractor beam projectors that could capture enemy ships.<ref name="EGWT" /> [[Pirate/Legends|Pirate]] forces also used tractor beams to immobilize targets for boarding.<ref name="NEGWT" />

These high-powered force fields could overpower their quarry's engines at times, to be maneuvered into a hangar or to hold them in position for boarding. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] had a book called ''[[Imperial Tractor Beam Primer]]'' with instructions on how to operate tractor beams.

Tractor beams consumed a lot of power, and required a skilled crew to operate them; while these two factors were a problem for many ships it was not for the largest ones.<ref name="DF:RA" />

Tractor beams were often coupled to the main [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] of large [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] to provide a constant stream of power to the device. However, interruption of the flow at any of the coupling sites would lead the beam to become inoperative. The [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station's]] tractor beams were linked to the station's reactor at seven locations, and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] disabled the system by only shutting down a single site.<ref name="NEGWT" />

==Countermeasures==
[[File:TractorBeam-PoV.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A [[HWK-290 light freighter/Legends|HWK-290 light freighter]] caught in a tractor beam]]
There were several novel ways to escape from a tractor beam. Very small craft with powerful engines could outmaneuver tractor beams if the ship's pilot was more cunning than the tractor-beam operator or [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]].

A [[Shroud (starship countermeasure)|shroud]] was a countermeasure device fitted to some space vessels. It functioned to confuse and displace the tracking lock of a tractor beam, enabling a ship to escape the hold of the beam.<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>

The tractor beams aboard the Death Star took energy from the main reactor, giving them a constant flow of power and making it impossible for a vessel caught in it to escape. However, if one of the tractor beam's seven links to the reactor was severed, the projectors would be inactive and vessels could escape, as [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was aware.

Tractor beams could also be disrupted by a [[Stage Three torpedo]]. These instances, however, were rare in relation to the number of times tractor beams reliably captured small vessels.

Another countermeasure was the [[Covert Shroud Maneuver|Covert Shroud]] gambit. While difficult to perform and requiring extensive preparation, the Covert Shroud was highly effective. It involved using the shell of a larger ship to contain a smaller one, along with a relatively weak [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]]. Once the larger ship was caught in a tractor beam, the pilot (and any other crew) would transfer to the smaller ship and activate the self-destruct. This would release the smaller ship and cause the tractor beam to catch the debris of the larger ship. The resulting delay would allow the smaller ship to escape to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] before the tractor beam could be re-targeted.<ref name="LastCommand">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|These things are the future, fill a ship with enough tractor beam arrays and you could prevent an enemy from jumping to hyperspace.|[[Travale]] to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Twist_of_fate_TCG.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Kenobi disables the tractor beam on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].]]
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Death Star's tractor beams captured the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. This led to the duel between [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and Obi-Wan Kenobi, during which Kenobi was killed.

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was almost captured twice by the tractor beams of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] flagship, the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']]. In the first instance, Luke fired a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] and at the very same instant reversed his [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engines]] in an unorthodox manner. This caused the tractor targeting computer to lock onto the torpedo, destroying the tractor beam projector. In the second instance, Luke used a large [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] as a disguise with his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] hidden inside. After the freighter was locked by the tractor beam, he destroyed the outer hull of the ship and escaped in the shielded X-wing, while the operator uselessly tried to regain the lock through the debris field of metal.

In orbit around Selonia, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] found himself in a crippled [[Selonian cone ship]] with no propulsion, orbit decaying, rapidly descending into the atmosphere. Meanwhile, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] in the ''[[Jade's Fire]]'' looked on helplessly, unable to affect the cone ship's trajectory with a tractor beam because the ships were of roughly equal size and the cone ship was already accelerating toward the planet, thus it had the greater momentum. A tractor beam would only have pulled both vessels to their doom.
